spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    cat.ref_month,
    100.0 AS "Estimated people with hypertension",
    (SUM(reg.cumulative_number_of_patients)::numeric
      / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0) * 100.0)
      AS "Cumulative registered patients",
    (SUM(cat.nb_patients_under_care_registered_before_the_past_3_months)::numeric
      / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0) * 100.0)
      AS "Patients under care",
    (SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled)::numeric
      / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0) * 100.0)
      AS "Patients with BP controlled"
  FROM heart360_patients_category cat
  JOIN heart360_patients_registered reg
    ON reg.ref_month = cat.ref_month AND reg.org_unit_id = cat.org_unit_id
  WHERE cat.ref_month = to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0)
    AND cat.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY 1
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeFrom()::timestamp),
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
    interval '3 months'
  )::date AS q
)
SELECT
  'Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM q.q)::int || '-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.q)::int
  AS quarter_label,

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'controlled' THEN 1 END), 0)
  AS "% Controlled BP at latest visit in following quarter",

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'uncontrolled' THEN 1 END), 0)
  AS "% Uncontrolled BP at latest visit in following quarter",

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'missed visit' THEN 1 END), 0)
  AS "% Patients with no visit in following quarter"

FROM quarters q
LEFT JOIN HEART360_COHORT_PATIENT_DETAILS c
  ON c.registration_quarter = q.q
  AND c.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
GROUP BY q.q
ORDER BY q.q
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    child_ou.id as child_id,
    child_ou.name as child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) as drill_url,
    CASE WHEN child_ou.level >= 5 THEN
      '/d/heart360_facility?var-Region=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 1), '') ||
      '&var-District=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 2), '') ||
      '&var-Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 3), '') ||
      '&var-Sub_Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 4), '')
    ELSE NULL END as facility_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(nb_new_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY cat
JOIN org_unit_lineage lin ON cat.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN heart360_patients_registered
    ON cat.ref_month = heart360_patients_registered.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = heart360_patients_registered.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
    ON cat.ref_month = uc.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = uc.org_unit_id
WHERE cat.ref_month = (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name, child_ou.level
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        ref_month AS "time",
        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
            THEN control_rate
        END AS "Historical",
        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month'
            THEN control_rate
        END AS "Current Month"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ref_month,
            100.00 * SUM(nb_patients_controlled)
            / (
                0.000001 + GREATEST(
                    0,
                    SUM(TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS)
                    - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED)
                    - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)
                )
            ) AS control_rate
        FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
        WHERE org_unit_id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM org_units
            WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL

            UNION

            SELECT id
            FROM get_descendant_ids(
                (
                    SELECT ou.id
                    FROM org_units ou
                    WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
                    LIMIT 1
                )
            )
        )
        GROUP BY ref_month
    ) AS data
) AS master_access_control
WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
ORDER BY "time"

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH selected_org AS (
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1)))
),
monthly_data AS (
  SELECT
    pr.ref_month,
    SUM(COALESCE(pr.nb_new_patients, 0)) AS nb_new_patients,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care
  FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_REGISTERED pr
  LEFT JOIN HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
    ON uc.ref_month = pr.ref_month
    AND uc.org_unit_id = pr.org_unit_id
  WHERE pr.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_org)
  GROUP BY pr.ref_month
)
SELECT
  ref_month,
  SUM(nb_new_patients) OVER (ORDER BY ref_month) AS cumulative_number_of_patients,
  nb_patients_under_care,
  nb_new_patients
FROM monthly_data
ORDER BY ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        ref_month AS "time",

        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
            THEN bp_140_90_rate
        END AS "% Patients with BP <140/90 - Historical",

        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month'
            THEN bp_140_90_rate
        END AS "% Patients with BP <140/90 - Current Month",

        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
            THEN bp_130_80_rate
        END AS "% Patients with BP <130/80 - Historical",

        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month'
            THEN bp_130_80_rate
        END AS "% Patients with BP <130/80 - Current Month"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            ref_month,

            100.0 * SUM(bp_controlled_140_90 + bp_controlled_130_80)
            / NULLIF(SUM(dm_patients_under_care), 0)
            AS bp_140_90_rate,

            100.0 * SUM(bp_controlled_130_80)
            / NULLIF(SUM(dm_patients_under_care), 0)
            AS bp_130_80_rate

        FROM HEART360_DM_BP_CONTROL

        WHERE org_unit_id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM org_units
            WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL

            UNION

            SELECT id
            FROM get_descendant_ids(
                (
                    SELECT ou.id
                    FROM org_units ou
                    WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
                    LIMIT 1
                )
            )
        )

        GROUP BY ref_month
    ) AS data

) AS master_access_control
WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
ORDER BY "time"

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        ref_month AS "time",
        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
            THEN blood_sugar_control_rate
        END AS "Historical",
        CASE
            WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', ref_month) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month'
            THEN blood_sugar_control_rate
        END AS "Current Month"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ref_month,
            SUM(100.0 * diabetes_controlled)
            / (0.00000001 + SUM(diabetes_patients_under_care)) AS blood_sugar_control_rate
        FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED
        WHERE org_unit_id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM org_units
            WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL

            UNION

            SELECT id
            FROM get_descendant_ids(
                (
                    SELECT ou.id
                    FROM org_units ou
                    WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
                    LIMIT 1
                )
            )
        )
        GROUP BY ref_month
    ) AS data
) AS master_access_control
WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT * FROM (
WITH months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp),
    date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
    '1 month'::interval
  )::date AS ref_month
)
SELECT
  months.ref_month AS "time",

  COALESCE(SUM(100.0 * s.uncontrolled_moderate) / NULLIF(SUM(s.diabetes_patients_under_care), 0), 0)
  AS "% Patients with FBS 126–199 mg/dL or HbA1c 7–8.9%",

  COALESCE(SUM(100.0 * s.uncontrolled_high) / NULLIF(SUM(s.diabetes_patients_under_care), 0), 0)

  COALESCE(SUM(100.0 * (s.uncontrolled_moderate + s.uncontrolled_high)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.diabetes_patients_under_care), 0), 0)
  AS "% Total Uncontrolled"

FROM months
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY s

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH latest_month AS (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) AS ref_month FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
SELECT
    child_ou.id AS child_id,
    child_ou.name AS child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) AS drill_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_dm_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_new_dm_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bss.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsm.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM org_unit_lineage lin
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN HEART360_DM_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc ON uc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND uc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED bsc ON bsc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY bss ON bss.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bss.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_MISSED_VISITS bsm ON bsm.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsm.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  patient_id,
  patient_name,
  registration_date,
  birth_date,
  gender,

  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = h.org_unit_id) AS facility,
  last_visit_date,

  last_bp_systolic,
  last_call_date,
  last_call_result AS result_type,
  COALESCE(removed_reason, '-') AS removed_reason,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(birth_date)) AS age_years,
  (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) AS days_since_last_visit,
  CASE
    WHEN last_bp_systolic IS NOT NULL AND last_bp_diastolic IS NOT NULL

        last_bp_diastolic::int

FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_PATIENTS h
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION

    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    to_char(s.eligible_adults, 'FM999,999,999') AS eligible_n,
    to_char(s.screened_adults, 'FM999,999,999') AS screened_n,
    to_char(s.suspected_htn, 'FM999,999,999') AS suspected_n,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.screened_adults / NULLIF(s.eligible_adults, 0))::int AS screened_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.suspected_htn / NULLIF(s.eligible_adults, 0))::int AS suspected_pct,
    s.screening_target_pct AS target_pct,
    to_char(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 'FM999,999,999') AS estimated_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.registered, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS registered_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.under_care, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS under_care_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.controlled, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS controlled_n,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.registered, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS registered_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.under_care, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS under_care_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.controlled, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS controlled_pct,
    to_char(to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0), 'Mon YYYY') AS month_label
  FROM demo_screening_cascade s
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      SUM(reg.cumulative_number_of_patients)::numeric AS registered,
      SUM(cat.nb_patients_under_care_registered_before_the_past_3_months)::numeric AS under_care,
      SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled)::numeric AS controlled
    FROM heart360_patients_category cat
    JOIN heart360_patients_registered reg
      ON reg.ref_month = cat.ref_month AND reg.org_unit_id = cat.org_unit_id
    WHERE cat.ref_month = to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0)
      AND cat.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  ) t ON TRUE
  WHERE s.id = 1
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1), 0) AS is_allowed
FROM grafana_schema.user u
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
  AND (
      u.is_admin = true
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
              WHERE t.name IN (
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
              )
          )
      )
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              t.name IN (
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'aggregated') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                  UNION
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'patients') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
              )
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
                  WHERE t.name IN (
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
                  )
                    AND hc.level <= (
                      SELECT level FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units
                      WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                      LIMIT 1
                    )
              )
          )
      )
  )
